title: PRISM：基于特权同级图引导的多智能体拓扑设计
summary: PRISM 提出一种利用特权信息训练多智能体协作拓扑生成器的方法：教师模型通过零初始化低秩分支读取部署时不可用的同级图，学生模型在自采样轨迹上匹配其决策目标，从而恢复每个查询的偏好信号。在六个基准上超越所有拓扑设计基线。
summary_en: PRISM introduces a privileged-information training method for multi-agent collaboration topology generators: a teacher reads a deployment-unavailable sibling graph via a zero-initialized low-rank branch, and the student matches its per-decision targets on self-sampled trajectories, recovering per-query preference signals. It outperforms all topology-design baselines across six benchmarks.
